interface.signature: def floodFill(image: List[List[int]], sr: int, sc: int, newColor: int) -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= sr < len(image) and 0 <= sc < len(image[0]) for image in [image])
preconditions.description: Starting coordinates (sr, sc) must be within the bounds of the image.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pixel <= 10 for row in image for pixel in row)
preconditions.description: All pixel values in the image must be integers between 0 and 10 (inclusive).
The newColor must be an integer between 0 and 10 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(image[i][j] == newColor if (i == sr and j == sc) or (i != sr or j != sc and image[i][j] == oldColor and is_connected(image, sr, sc, i, j, oldColor)) else image[i][j] for i in range(len(image)) for j in range(len(image[0])))
postconditions.description: All pixels connected 4-directionally to (sr, sc) with the same original color (oldColor) are updated to newColor, while others remain unchanged.
